steps.title: First, a record a person wrote
steps.body: Bread trial 7. Only the flour changed, yet at the same 75% hydration the loaf collapsed. This record is the only thing a person wrote; everything from here on was built by the AI

steps.title: A topic the AI built from the records
steps.body: A topic the AI raised after reading the records. Every key point ends with an @ back to its record, and points where the records disagree go under "Disagreements & open questions"

steps.title: A chat, recorded
steps.body: Asked about whole wheat, the AI answers from the trial records and the reading notes. Click a citation to open the source. To ask your own question, connect an AI in Settings
